dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I might not have won this iteration of Masterful Chefs, but I definitely learned a lot from the competition itself!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I was just planning to invent a few new dishes for the Moonchase Festival and maybe learn a few things from Chef Xiangling, but I sure learned quite a few unexpected things, too!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...Actually, what are you doing, just sauntering on into the kitchen again?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Ah, so Yanxiao came in second this year. A shame, but also not a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Cooking is much like martial arts. One can only improve when rivals to compete with.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I'll bet that he's cooking up some new recipes as we speak. Well, I sure hope I'll get to try some of it.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hello! I am Huai'an, innkeeper of the Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Our inn is a fine vantage spot for moon-viewing. The view from the top floor is excellent, with obstructed views of the moon and of the surrounding scenery alike.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Hello! Oh! Well, you certainly are a returning customer. Welcome back.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: You've come at a good time: the Moonchase Festival is the best time for viewing the moon and enjoying gourmet food, and Wangshu Inn has plenty of both.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, child, it's you! The Moonchase Festival is a most lively time here in Liyue, so feel free to walk around and see the sights.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Stove God...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Well, now you know that the Moonchase Festival was instituted by Rex Lapis as a way of remember that friend of ours.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You call him Guoba nowadays, do you not? Hehe, I suppose it was destiny that led Xiangling to rename the God of the Stove for a dish they both enjoyed.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Take him around Liyue Harbor — you and Xiangling both — a little more, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: I'm sure he would be gladdened to see Liyue Harbor as populous as it presently is.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Hello there, youngster. Here to enjoy the Moonchase Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Back in the day, we would eat Wangxiao Cakes, drink Laurel Wine, and gather together with family and friends to share our hopes for the future.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Nowadays, the number dishes to be had has grown and grown, and we aren't quite as particular as we once were — we simply eat whatever we wish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Take the opportunity to try some more of Liyue's delicacies, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Here for the Wanmin Restaurant experience? Hi, I'm Chef Mao. Everyone in Chihu Rock will have heard of me.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: My name might not be the most famous around, but my daughter Xiangling is the champion of this year's Masterful Chefs. Now hers is a name I'm sure everyone's heard of!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Haha! That's my dear girl alright, our very own culinary genius. Her future is very bright indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and with it, the Masterful Chefs tournament. All the Liyue locals are getting fired up about good food again, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Should I take this chance to try a few more Liyue dishes? Oh, but the food here is just...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's the Moonchase Festival, and the food here's only getting better... But my brother is still as weak as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I've heard that this iteration of Masterful Chefs has seen quite a few new dishes come to light. You know what? I'm just going to drag him off to try them all one by one!

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I'm pumped to try something different form the usual fare. After all, they're just... you know, there.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Manager Kuan! I want the moon!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Hey, aren't each of your requests becoming less reasonable than the last? Also, for the last time, just call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Nope. Also, my requests are not that unreasonable.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Isn't the Moonchase Festival all about chasing the moon? If you can get it for me, Manager Kuan, then no one will have to chase it.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: That would make you everyone's hero, Manager Kuan!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: I'm not some hero, I'm just Kuan... No, wait, I'm your Daddy!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Well, if you're my Daddy, and then you can fulfill my wishes, right? I'll study hard, and you'll get me the moon. That's fair, right?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: I don't think this is a question of fairness. It's more that... I can't get the moon in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: *sigh* Then until you get the moon, you're not a hero, you're Manager Kuan.

dialogues.speaker: Yicheng
dialogues.text: Hello there! *LOUD RUMBLING* Happy *RUMBLE* Moonchase Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Yicheng
dialogues.text: Eat more at the *RUMBLE* Masterful Chefs...

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: C'mon, Li Cuisine was clearly the superior tradition this time at Masterful Chefs!

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Oh sure, that sounds like something only Li lovers would say!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: Well, why don't you just accept that there's nothing redeemable about Yue Cuisine? Did you see that boiled fish dish in the qualifiers? Made that judge's face turn green just from tasting it! You could smell the rank flavor of soil from a mile away...

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: W—Well, it's not like Li Cuisine fared any better. I heard that one of the judges failed to show up at the finals because they got a tummy ache from tasting some Li Cuisine during the semi-finals!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: Nonsense! A tummy ache's got nothing to do with the dish's taste. Li Cuisine is just superior!

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Hmph, you're clearly only saying that because you've never properly tried Yue food before. I bet you've never even BEEN to the Xinyue Kiosk!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: And I bet YOU have never had proper Li cuisine at Liuli Pavilion!

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Welcoming the bright moonlight to illuminate the adeptal path — what a romantic scene!

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I should really start collecting some antiques related to the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: It's festival time here in Liyue again. Thanks for accepting my invitation to view the moon together...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: I'd originally planned to invite you to some famous restaurant, but I didn't think that they'd been fully booked ages ago...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: It's alright. I've heard that the theme of this festival is gourmet food. It's not all that surprising that there were no tables left.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Eh? I—Is that so... So that's why I couldn't book any seats...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Looks like my lack of understanding about Liyue was to blame. I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, no, you don't have to apologize...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Just being able to relax and watch the bright moon together is good enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Don't you think the moon at this time is brighter and rounder than usual?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Oh, is it? ...No, I mean... You're right. It truly is very beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and Daddy still isn't back...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: The latest Masterful Chefs was super exciting. I've started learning how to cook, too!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Once Daddy gets back, I'll make him something nice for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: *sigh* And here I was thinking that I'd be able to take a break during the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Instead, I've been working overtime due to the large increase in the demand for cooking ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Well, what can I say? I guess everyone here just loves to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome to the Moonchase Festival here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: The theme of this year's Moonchase Festival is gourmet food, and this iteration of Masterful Chefs is being organized by the Liyue Qixing themselves. With all the great chefs taking part, this is one show you don't want to miss!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I hope that everyone will have a good time during the festival. Of course, if you do have civil affairs at hand, please direct your concerns to the Ministry.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Haha! It was the right call to come here during the festival. You just can't beat the festive cheer here in the city!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I've heard that the Moonchase Festival used to be celebrated for very different reasons in the past. Something about the adepti's rituals, I believe.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: But I don't think that what it's about now — gathering together and admiring the moon — is half bad, either!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I'm sure that the adepti, too, would be gladdened to see everyone enjoying themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Have you heard the news? Captain Beidou of the Crux brought something amazing back from overseas again!

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: They say that it's the statue of an ancient adeptus... Or a god... Well, whatever it is, it's a really awesome statue!

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Well, it's the Crux Fleet, you know? Anything they're packing is bound to be good. Well then. Would you like something today, friend?

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival really is a busy time. Looking at all the locals running about preparing food, I can't help but be tempted to try my hand at it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Do you think some Snezhnayan fare and some grilled pies and such would sell well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Moonchase Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The meaning of the Festival in ages past was quite different. It was about the ancients of Liyue seeking the adeptal path.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Nowadays, it's more about admiring the moon, eating, and enjoying our time together with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The meaning of festivals will shift with time, and some traditions will be forgotten. However, everyone's hopes for the future will remain the same, no matter what the day or age.
